export declare const COMPOSER_PICK_INPUT_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const COMPOSER_PICK_INPUT_TYPE = "molis.composer.pick.query.v1";

export declare const COMPOSER_PICK_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const COMPOSER_PICK_OUTPUT_TYPE = "molis.composer.pick.items.v1";

export type ComposerMaterial = {
    kind: "attachment";
    ref: string;
    title: string;
} | {
    kind: "material";
    ref: MaterialRef;
    title: string;
    source: {
        capability_id: string;
        version: number;
        provider_id: string;
    };
    search?: {
        hit_id: string;
        snippet: string;
        plugin_id: string;
        plugin_title: string;
    };
};

export interface ComposerPickInput {
    query: string;
    limit: number;
    near?: ActionSubject;
}

export interface ComposerPickItem {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    title: string;
    hint?: string;
}

export interface ComposerPickOutput {
    items: ComposerPickItem[];
}

export interface ComposerSourceDeclaration {
    readonly title: string;
    readonly title_text?: {
        readonly key: string;
    };
    readonly layers: readonly ("ai" | "plain")[];
}

export declare const composerErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly source_unavailable: "unavailable";
    readonly subject_unreadable: "not_found";
    readonly required_missing: "invalid";
}>;
